history.description: The Fondo Assistenza Sanitaria is instituted by Rescritto d'Udienza of 25 July 1953, amended by a rescript of 7 November 1994
The Law on the Government of Vatican City State of 16 July 2002 defines the purposes and territorial competences of the health directorate
Pope Francis approves a new Statute and Regolamento of the Fondo Assistenza Sanitaria by Rescritto d'Udienza of 18 October 2016, in force from 1 February 2017
A new Regolamento of the Direzione di Sanita e Igiene takes effect on 1 March 2022
Article 3 of the F.A.S. Regolamento is amended by rescript of 1 August 2025, governing enrolment of an assisted person's family members
history.evidenceKey: 2025 amendment of art. 3 of the FAS Regolamento

notEstablished.terminology: Not established from the sources consulted. No French or vernacular term for a childhood language disorder is fixed in any Wallis and Futuna instrument found. The vice-rectorat's own Ecole inclusive service page gives the service's remit as 'adaptation scolaire' and the schooling of 'eleves en situation de handicap' and names no disorder category; the territory's 'Scolarisation des eleves a besoins educatifs particuliers, chiffres 2018' counts pupils only by ULIS, SEGPA and RASED placement; the vice-rectorat's Vademecum 2017 names orthophonie only as a form of care that is not available on the territory, never as a condition; and the Senate's 2025 report on overseas disability policy records that the 2005 disability law is not applicable there and that no equivalent local text has been adopted. None of these, nor the education ministry's own fiche on French-language mastery in Wallis and Futuna, uses 'trouble du langage', 'dysphasie' or 'TSLA'.

history.description: Article 68 of the 1972 finance law puts the cost of health care in the territory on the State
An ordonnance of 13 January 2000 creates the Agence de sante, charged with drawing up the territory's health programme and with dispensing medicines
